(`ip-10-3-26-165.ap-south-1.compute.internal`, user `s2025ae05141`) on 2026-10-20.

## eda/ (generated by `notebooks/01_eda.ipynb`)
| File | Shows |
|---|---|
| `class_balance.png` | 164 no disease vs 139 disease |
| `numeric_histograms.png` | distributions of the 5 numeric features, split by target |
| `categorical_disease_rate.png` | disease rate for every value of the 8 categorical features |
| `correlation_heatmap.png` | correlations between all features and the target |

## models/ (generated by `src/train.py`, test set)
ROC curve and confusion matrix for Logistic Regression and Random Forest.
